work.name: Capital One
highlights: Developing a generalized evaluation framework to benchmark LLM and agentic system performance.
Improve validation components for a production multi-agent system, verifying factual accuracy of generated outputs in high-volume customer-service workflows.

work.name: Comcast
highlights: Built distributed data pipeline using PySpark to process large-scale conversation datasets and added LLM supervision into clustering frameworks using LangChain, LLM Tool/Function Calling to improve the categorization.
Designed a hierarchical, multi-layered clustering framework by integrating LLM-based verification and summarization into agglomerative clustering to create descriptive cluster hierarchies.
Developed LLM-based evaluation frameworks for comparing the different unsupervised clustering methods.

work.name: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University
highlights: Creating a large-scale multimodal (text-video-audio) evaluation dataset & LLM-based method for event/entity extraction and relation extraction (event matching/search) to reduce the information gap between modalities.
Improving the object and part detection of LLMs using LLM post-training, i.e., reinforcement learning (PPO, GRPO).
Uncovering security vulnerabilities in multimodal LLMs via novel adversarial attack in realistic black-box setting.

work.name: IQVIA
highlights: Created IQVIA's AI-Assistant by fine-tuning (SFT) LLaMA model on business-specific use cases to enhance user experience and product engagement.
Finetuned LLM via QLoRA and quantized with AutoAWQ that reduced response time by 54% and memory usage by 73%.
Designed and deployed production LLM serving infrastructure using vLLM on AWS cloud, implementing autoscaling, monitoring, and GPU inference optimization.
Experimented retrieval augmented generation (RAG) based solution to accommodate fast changing information.
Enhanced IQVIA's recommendation algorithms suite, generating over $10M in annual revenue, and contributed to the deployment & MLOps pipeline of these models using Kubeflow & Kubernetes.

work.name: Xu Lab - Carnegie Mellon University
highlights: Improved the understanding of different sentence components in video-language joint learning tasks
Devised a solution to detect anomalous events in automated tools during experiments in a laboratory using recorded videos.
